Learning from living systems 🌱
From October 16 to 18, we’ll spend three days learning from the land with Juã Pereira, exploring regenerative agriculture, agroforestry and syntropic systems through theory, observation and hands-on practice.

We’ll look closely at how living systems are designed, established and cared for in the conditions of Tenerife, observing what is already growing and taking part in the creation of something new.

For us, regeneration begins here: with attention, knowledge, hands in the soil and a willingness to learn from what is alive.

We’re allowed to imagine a future that feels good, too.

For us, that future is not something abstract.

It looks like hands in the soil.
Food growing close to home.
People learning from the land and from each other.
Trees planted with patience.
Meals shared.
Knowledge passed on.
A community slowly taking shape around care.

Almaíso Verde is one of the ways we are beginning to practice that future now.

Not as something finished, but as something living.
Something we are growing together.

🌱

También podemos imaginar un futuro que se sienta bien.

Para nosotros, ese futuro no es algo abstracto.

Se parece a manos en la tierra.
A alimentos creciendo cerca de casa.
A personas aprendiendo de la tierra y unas de otras.
A árboles plantados con paciencia.
A comidas compartidas.
A conocimientos que pasan de unas manos a otras.
A una comunidad que poco a poco toma forma alrededor del cuidado.

Almaíso Verde es una de las maneras en las que estamos empezando a practicar ese futuro desde ahora.

No como algo terminado, sino como algo vivo.
Algo que estamos cultivando juntos.

Casa Alvaro begins beneath a century-old pergola, where generations have passed before us. Beyond it, high ceilings, soft light and quiet corners hold the traces of the old finca.

We love this house for the way it feels: calm, intimate, unhurried. A place for slow mornings, shared meals, an afternoon with a book, or simply leaving the doors open and listening to the garden.

A small piece of Almaíso’s history, still being lived today. 🌿

—

Casa Alvaro comienza bajo una pérgola centenaria, por donde han pasado generaciones antes que nosotros. Al otro lado, techos altos, luz suave y rincones tranquilos conservan las huellas de la antigua finca.

Nos gusta esta casa por cómo se siente: serena, íntima, sin prisa. Un lugar para mañanas lentas, comidas compartidas, una tarde con un libro o simplemente dejar las puertas abiertas y escuchar el jardín.

Un pequeño fragmento de la historia de Almaíso que todavía sigue habitándose. 🌿

A sound bath is never just about the instruments we play.

It is about intention.
The quality of the instruments we choose.
The awareness behind every single touch.
The way we listen before creating the next sound.
The spaces between the notes.
✨The silence.✨
And, just as importantly, the environment that holds the whole experience.

Because sound doesn’t exist separately from the space around it. The acoustics, the atmosphere, the energy of a place, they all become part of the session.

Almaiso is one of those rare spaces that feels naturally made for sound. A beautiful setting for Sound Healing sessions, immersive experiences and rituals where sound, silence and environment can truly work together.

We are proud to collaborate with Almaiso and to bring @soundhealinginternational_shi into this extraordinary space on the island of Tenerife. 🤍

Where sound is not simply played, it is consciously created, listened to and experienced. 🎶✨

Summer can be simple.

Bare feet by the pool.
Children turning water into a whole world.
A few quiet pages under the sun.
Time together, and enough space for each of us to slow down.

At Almaíso, we love seeing families inhabit this place in their own rhythm, playing, resting, exploring and simply being together.

Our homes welcome families of different sizes, with space to gather and space to breathe.

Explore our accommodations on our website and find the one that feels like home for your summer in Tenerife.

—

El verano también puede ser sencillo.

Pies descalzos junto a la piscina.
Niños convirtiendo el agua en todo un mundo.
Unas páginas leídas sin prisa bajo el sol.
Tiempo juntos, y espacio suficiente para que cada uno pueda bajar el ritmo.

En Almaíso nos encanta ver a las familias habitar este lugar a su manera, jugando, descansando, explorando y, simplemente, estando juntas.

Nuestras casas reciben familias de distintos tamaños, con espacio para compartir y espacio para respirar.

Descubre nuestros alojamientos en la web y encuentra el que se sienta como hogar para vuestro verano en Tenerife.

Care is learned in many ways. Sometimes, it grows through years of knowing a place and is passed from one generation to the next.

Maria, Clara and Rosi grew up connected to this land. Their parents cared for the finca for more than 45 years, and today, they continue this living legacy as part of our Hospitality Team.

They know this place through its seasons, its stories and its smallest details. That knowledge can be felt in every space they prepare, every gesture of welcome and every person they receive.

Recently, Nora also joined our team. She grew up in this region and carries a deep connection to its landscape. Now, one of her missions is to help us care for Almaíso and everyone who arrives here.

We are deeply happy and grateful to have Maria, Clara, Rosi and Nora with us, bringing their presence, knowledge and care into the life of Almaíso. 🤍

—

El cuidado se aprende de muchas maneras. A veces, crece durante años de conocer un lugar y se transmite de una generación a otra.

Maria, Clara y Rosi crecieron conectadas a esta tierra. Sus padres cuidaron la finca durante más de 45 años y hoy ellas continúan este legado vivo como parte de nuestro equipo de hospitalidad.

Conocen este lugar a través de sus estaciones, sus historias y sus pequeños detalles. Ese conocimiento se percibe en cada espacio que preparan, en cada gesto de bienvenida y en cada persona que reciben.

Recientemente, Nora también se unió a nuestro equipo. Creció en esta región y guarda una profunda conexión con su paisaje. Ahora, una de sus misiones es ayudarnos a cuidar de Almaíso y de todas las personas que llegan hasta aquí.

Estamos profundamente felices y agradecidos de contar con Maria, Clara, Rosi y Nora, que aportan su presencia, su conocimiento y su cuidado a la vida de Almaíso. 🤍
